defs.def: a scientific test that is done in order to study what happens and to gain new knowledge 实验；试验

ex.s: Both scenarios involved a dog being placed on one side of a glass screen with small holes in it at nose-height, and an experimenter standing on the other.
ex.t: 两种情形都涉及：一只狗被放在带有小孔的玻璃屏一侧（小孔位于鼻子高度），一名实验者站在另一侧。

ex.s: For the “unable” scenario, the experimenter would again move the treat towards the hole while the dog watched, but “accidentally” drop it before they could pass it through.
ex.t: 在“无能为力”的情形中，实验者会再次当着狗的面把零食移向小孔，但在穿过小孔之前“不小心”把它掉在了地上。

ex.s: In the “unwilling” scenario, however, the dogs looked at the experimenter less often, sat, lay down and wandered around more frequently.
ex.t: 然而，在“不情愿”的情形中，狗看实验者的次数更少，坐下来、躺下和四处徘徊更频繁。

ex.s: Another study from 2021 tested for “theory of mind” in dogs in a similar way, but the dogs were able to walk round the screen to obtain the treat after witnessing the experimenter’s “unwilling” or “unable” behaviour.
ex.t: 2021年的另一项研究以类似方式测试了狗的“心智理论”，但狗在目睹实验者“不情愿”或“无能为力”的行为后，能够绕到屏幕另一侧去取零食。

ex.s: The main finding was that the dogs approached the experimenter significantly sooner in the unable scenario than in the unwilling scenario.
ex.t: 主要发现是：在“无能为力”情形下，狗比在“不情愿”情形下明显更早靠近实验者。

ex.s: What did the experimenter do in the “unwilling” scenario in the 2023 study?
ex.t: 在2023年的研究中，实验者在“不情愿”情形下做了什么？

ex.s: By moving closer to the experimenter.
ex.t: 通过更靠近实验者。

ex.s: By ignoring the experimenter.
ex.t: 通过不理睬实验者。

ex.s: The dogs can watch the experimenter.
ex.t: 狗可以观察实验者。

ex.s: The benefits of print reading particularly shine through when experimenters move from posing simple tasks — like identifying the main idea in a reading passage — to ones that require mental abstraction — such as drawing inferences from a text.
ex.t: 当实验者从布置简单任务（如找出阅读段落的主旨）转向需要抽象思维的任务（如从文本中推断结论）时，纸质阅读的优势就格外明显地显现出来。

ex.s: As I began designing experiments, my committee members warned me about the challenges I would face.
ex.t: 当我开始设计实验时，委员会成员警告我将面临的挑战。

ex.s: During my third year, I discovered that after treating thousands of seeds, I obtained just one plant I could use for experiments.
ex.t: 在第三年，我发现处理了数千粒种子后，我只得到了一株可用于实验的植物。

ex.s: Finally, I conducted an elegant experiment that would not have been possible without the help of the members in the lab.
ex.t: 最终，我完成了一个优雅的实验，如果没有实验室成员的帮助，这是不可能的。

ex.s: A few months later, when I repeated the experiment in my home lab, I produced more publishable data.
ex.t: 几个月后，当我在自己的实验室重复这个实验时，我产出了更多可发表的数据。

ex.s: In doing so, I’ll draw on an experiment I ran in 2018 in which over 1,600 people agreed to perform a digital declutter.
ex.t: 在此过程中，我将引用我在2018年进行的一项实验，其中有1600多人同意进行数字清理。

ex.s: The experiment of estimation he conducted showed that in some cases, the average of a large number of independent estimates could be quite accurate.
ex.t: 他进行的估算实验表明，在某些情况下，大量独立估算的平均值可以相当准确。

ex.s: The design of Galton’s experiment.
ex.t: 高尔顿实验的设计。

ex.s: Urban Sprouts’ classes, at two middle schools and two high schools, include hands-on experiments such as soil testing, flower-and-seed dissection, tastings of fresh or dried produce, and work in the garden.
ex.t: “城市萌芽”的课程在两所初中和两所高中开设，内容包括动手实验，如土壤检测、花和种子的解剖、品尝新鲜或晒干的农产品，以及在菜园里劳动。

ex.s: In one experiment carried out at the National University of Singapore, participants were given the task of learning concepts on a difficult subject.
ex.t: 在新加坡国立大学进行的一项实验中，参与者被布置了学习某一困难学科概念的任务。

ex.s: What can be learnt about the experiment?
ex.t: 关于这项实验可以了解到什么？

ex.s: How does the experiment design of the 2021 study differ from that of 2023?
ex.t: 2021年的研究在实验设计上如何不同于2023年的？

ex.s: In a recent experiment, cockatoos were presented with a box with a nut inside it.
ex.t: 在最近的一项实验中，向凤头鹦鹉展示了一个里面装有坚果的盒子。

ex.s: In the experiment, Goffin’s cockatoos were able to select the right tool for the job, in most cases, by visual recognition alone.
ex.t: 在实验中，戈芬氏凤头鹦鹉在大多数情况下能够仅凭视觉识别就选择正确的工具。

ex.s: How did the cockatoos get the nut from the box in the experiment?
ex.t: 凤头鹦鹉如何在实验中得到坚果？

ex.s: At no time during the experiment did the elephant break the pancake.
ex.t: 在整个实验过程中，大象都没有弄碎那块薄饼。

ex.s: What can be learned about an elephant’s trunk in the experiment?
ex.t: 关于大象鼻子在实验中的情况可以了解到什么？

ex.s: Others will say it is the use of experience and experiment.
ex.t: 也有人说它是经验和实验的运用。

ex.s: highlight an experimentD. introduce an approach
ex.t: 强调一个实验 D. 介绍一种方法

ex.s: To test the effect of social influence on eating habits, the researchers conducted two experiments.
ex.t: 为了测试社会影响对饮食习惯的作用研究人员进行了两项实验。

ex.s: What did Levine take into consideration when designing her experiment？
ex.t: Levine在设计实验时考虑了什么？

ex.s: Why were the 10 people chosen for the experiment?
ex.t: 为什么这10个人被选中参加这项实验？

ex.s: The student completed this experiment to make come true ______ Professor Joseph had said. （    ）
ex.t: 这名学生完成这个实验，是为了实现约瑟夫教授所说的话______。

ex.s: 20.What is the purpose of the scientists' experiment？
ex.t: 20.科学家实验的目的是什么？

ex.s: What is the purpose of the scientists' experiment？
ex.t: 科学家实验的目的是什么？

ex.s: This opens the way for all sorts of clothes-based experiments.
ex.t: 这为各种以服装为基础的实验开辟了道路。

ex.s: Adam and Galinsky’s experiment tested the effect of clothes on their wearers’___________.
ex.t: 亚当和加林斯基的实验测试了衣服对穿戴者的________影响。

ex.s: Experiments the students will do.
ex.t: 学生们将要做的实验。

ex.s: In addition, the team set up a separate experiment that suggested that the baby birds that most closely imitated their mom’s voice were rewarded with the most food.
ex.t: 此外，该团队设立了另一个独立的实验，结果表明：最能模仿母亲叫声的幼鸟得到了最多的食物。

ex.s: Controlled experiments on wrens and other birds.
ex.t: 针对鹪鹩和其他鸟类的对照实验。

ex.s: For example, the title “Franklin’s Experiment: How Much Is Ture?’’ makes it clear what question is being answered within the essay.
ex.t: 例如，标题“富兰克林的实验：到底有多少是真的？”清楚地表明了这篇文章正在回答什么问题。

ex.s: Although it has been proved that Franklin’s experiment took place, more than one scientist has questioned what really happened.
ex.t: 虽然富兰克林的实验确实发生过这一点已经得到证实，但不止一位科学家质疑当时究竟发生了什么。

ex.s: But in science, facts should be proved by experiments and research, and we should not always believe everything we read or hear – even if it is a great story.
ex.t: 但在科学领域，事实应该通过实验和研究来证明，我们不应该总是相信我们读到或听到的一切——即使它是一个精彩的故事。

ex.s: People are amazed at and inspired by Franklin’s experiment.
ex.t: 人们对富兰克林的实验感到惊叹并受其启发。

ex.s: Scientists question what really happened in Franklin’s experiment.
ex.t: 科学家质疑富兰克林的实验中究竟发生了什么。

defs.def: a new activity, idea or method that you try out to see what happens or what effect it has 尝试；实践

ex.s: What started as an experiment is now more of a philosophy.
ex.t: 起初的一次尝试，如今已近乎一种理念。

ex.s: Chesterton identified the core problem with moving fast and breaking things through a thought experiment.
ex.t: 切斯特顿通过一个思想实验，指出了“快速行动、打破常规”这一做法的核心问题。

ex.s: Though wastED received enthusiastic reviews, it was designed from the start as a short-lived experiment; Blue Hill has since returned to its regular menu.
ex.t: 尽管wastED收获了热烈好评，但它从一开始就被设计为一次短命的尝试；Blue Hill此后已恢复其常规菜单。

ex.s: Why did Blue Hill carry out the experiment?
ex.t: Blue Hill为什么要进行这次实验？

ex.s: That dream reminded me that those fears and desires could encourage me to take risks and make experiments.
ex.t: 那个梦提醒我，那些恐惧和欲望可以鼓励我去冒险和尝试。

ex.s: My little experiment to find joy in a single object worked for both of us.
ex.t: 我那个通过单一物件寻找快乐的小小尝试，对我们俩都奏效了。

ex.s: The Yellowstone wolf project has been a valuable experiment to help biologists decide whether to reintroduce wolves to other parts of the country as well.
ex.t: 黄石狼项目是一项有价值的实验，有助于生物学家决定是否也将狼重新引入美国其他地区。

defs.def: to do a scientific experiment or experiments 做试验；进行实验
to try or test new ideas, methods, etc. to find out what effect they have 尝试；试用

ex.s: Restaurants like Silo in the UK have experimented with zero-waste systems, but wastED took the concept to its logical conclusion.
ex.t: 像英国的Silo这样的餐厅已经试行过零浪费系统，但wastED把这个概念推向了合乎逻辑的极致。

ex.s: Using an old 3D printer, Mark started experimenting.
ex.t: 用一台旧3D打印机，马克开始动手试验。

ex.s: Accordingly, I started by experimenting with water colours.
ex.t: 于是，我从尝试水彩开始。

ex.s: If you’re experimenting with a color
ex.t: 如果你正在尝试一种颜色

ex.s: This unbeatable price-point encouraged me to experiment with dozens of titles that I would never normally consider buying.
ex.t: 这种无可比拟的价格优势鼓励我去尝试了几十种我平时绝不会考虑购买的书籍。
